synopsis: ISO/TS 5083:2025 covers the design, verification and validation of automated driving systems [f15319]. The glossary also groups it with the ISO 3450x series as road-vehicle standards for describing, sorting and choosing automated-driving test scenarios [f15312]. Chapter 12 identifies ISO/TS 5083:2025, alongside SOTIF (ISO 21448:2022), as applicable to the perception-model gap, while explicitly treating them as on-road evidence [f10339]. For off-road planning, the glossary limits ISO/TS 5083 and the related standards to methodological precedent rather than off-road compliance evidence, citing their road-vehicle and limited-access-highway scope [f15320]. These standards establish no physical-to-virtual testing ratio, so they do not supply that planning parameter [f15321].

relations.note: Clarifies the on-road evidence designation and limits its use for off-road compliance.
Design, verification and validation coverage supports its relevance to the perception-model gap.
Road-vehicle scenario scope supports treating the standard as precedent, not off-road compliance evidence.
Adds a specific methodological limitation: no physical-to-virtual testing ratio.
